correction1_sendPairing.defect: The observer reports from inside the send delegate, so it could set the completion and raise _sent while the delegate then threw. The catch removed only the dictionary entry, so a failed send stayed counted and a run could reach its total before every message had been sent.
correction1_sendPairing.resolution: A send is published only when both facts hold: observer completion and a delegate that returned without throwing. Whichever arrives second publishes, through one CompareExchange on a claim flag, so no published counter is ever taken back and a failure is terminal in either order.
